Additionally, what I want you to do in this specific scenario, only when people paste a prompt that match those criteria, not when actually people type. I want you to incredibly change the generate call to action button language to the language of the detected prompt and I want you to shake that button with some animation CSS using a screw of 45 degrees on both sides like a Elex maybe but not like completely rotating just shaking it from both sides
